name: Punta del Este Laguna del Sauce International Airport (C/C Carlos A. Curbelo)

runway.v: two runways; the longer, 08/26, is 2,133 m x 45 m; 01/19 is 1,600 m x 38 m

customs.v: customs and immigration same hours as the aerodrome operator (24 hours)
customs.quote: Igual que el Explotador del AD

noise.v: noise abatement on all departures; from runway 08 no right turn before 1,500 ft (450 m) altitude
noise.quote: los virajes a la derecha no podrán ser efectuados antes de alcanzar 1.500 FT (450 M) de altitud

max_aircraft.v: B787 limited to MTOM 169,400 kg; central apron code C only, some transit stands limited to 18 m or 20 m span

fuel.quote: Igual que el Explotador del AD

handling.v: ground handling by the aerodrome operator
handling.quote: Igual que el Explotador del AD

notes: Read: DINACIA AIP Uruguay AD 2.5 SULS (Spanish), file of April 2026, latest page date 16 APR 2026, AIRAC AIP AMDT NR 08 on some pages, https://www.dinacia.gub.uy/sites/default/files/aip/2026-04/Ad2-5%20(6).pdf . High season 15 Dec - 15 Mar: 'Durante este período se prevén demoras en las operaciones especialmente los días viernes, domingos'; pilots get the expected departure delay from aerodrome operations before start-up (no formal slot or PPR rule stated, so listed as missing). Fuel quote refers to the H24 hours of the fuel service. No curfew stated. A newer July 2026 SULS file may exist (SUMU had a 2026-07 file); not found in search. IATA code not stated.
